description: docs/phase-0/11_VERTICAL_SLICE.md §11.4 worked example, plus the near-miss and legitimate-recurring cases §11.5's acceptance criteria require (items 2, 3).

purchases.case: exact-duplicate-pair (T1 — same vendor, date, amount, account)
exact-duplicate-pair (the duplicate) — docNumber intentionally differs, see note below
purchases._finding: Capability-spike finding, 2026-08-16: QBO enforces unique DocNumber per company by default (fault 6140, 'Duplicate Document Number Error') -- attempting the spec's literal worked example (both postings sharing DocNumber 4471) fails seed creation outright. This is genuinely useful: it means VL-DUP-EXP-001's T2 tier (same vendor/amount/non-empty DocNumber) can only fire in practice for a client with 'Custom transaction numbers' enabled in company settings -- otherwise QBO itself already prevents the shared-DocNumber case from existing. T1 (same vendor/date/amount/account, docNumber not compared) still exercises correctly with this adjustment.

purchases.case: near-miss — same amount, different vendor — must NOT match (§11.5 item 2)
T3 near-date — same vendor/amount/account, 2 days apart — expect .medium confidence (§11.5 item 3)
T3 near-date — the second, 2 days later
